method: NAIVE and AS PUBLISHED. Written in one pass from official web pages (MOM, TADM, CPF Board) read on 12 October 2026, using only the writing-l4-rules conventions. Administrative policy, not law: no statutory text was encoded. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Tripartite Advisory on Managing Excess Manpower and Responsible Retrenchment, '(Updated 20 January 2023)', Annex C part II, and MOM's 'Responsible retrenchment' page (last updated 14 July 2026) with three MOM FAQs (14 March 2024) and TADM's 'I have been retrenched' FAQ (2 March 2026); CPF Board 'Workfare Income Supplement' page (last updated 18 June 2026, Work Year 2024 and 2025 tables), WIS eligibility criteria (23 July 2026) and the WIS employee Work Year 2026 calculator (3 August 2026). All read 12 October 2026.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to REQ-0276. Retrenchment benefit: the Advisory's 2-year eligibility, the norm of two weeks' to one month's salary per year of service (two weeks read naively as half a month; the 12/26 alternative given), the unionised one-month norm, the pre-cut salary rule, the Employee Assistance Payment alternative at 63 and over (named only), no CPF on retrenchment benefit, and TADM's 6-month claim window; plus MOM's statement that retrenchment benefit is not mandated by law. Workfare Income Supplement for employees: citizenship, age 30 (or disability), the monthly income band ($500 floor, waived for concessionary groups; $2,500 cap in WY2024, $3,000 from WY2025) and the 12-month average, the home annual value limit, the one-property and spouse-income tests, maximum yearly WIS by age band (employees and self-employed, WY2024 and WY2025), the 40/60 cash/CPF split (10/90 for self-employed), and the month of payment. Not encoded: the WIS amount for a given income (not published on the pages read), platform workers, self-employed MediSave conditions, concessionary WIS levels, Work Years before 2024, the ex-gratia payment and the Employee Assistance Payment amounts, and the rest of the Advisory.
